_comment: The 7-day clock and the tags it uses (spec 36 section 5). Change the numbers here; no code change needed.

intro_lead.subject: {first}, meet {partner_first}
intro_lead.body:
Hi {first},

Thanks for talking with us. I'm connecting you with {partner_name}{at_company}, who works on exactly this kind of request. {partner_first} will reach out within a day or so.

You can also reach them directly: {partner_reach}.

If you don't hear back, reply here and I'll sort it out.

Justin
Find Me Money Group

intro_partner.title: New lead: {name}. Please make contact within 48 hours

nudge_partner.title: {name}: no contact logged yet
nudge_partner.body: It's been {hours} hours since we sent you {name}. Have you reached them? Move the stage or use your status link so we know.{status_line}

status_partner.title: {name}: where does this stand?
status_partner.body: It's been a week since we sent you {name}. Where is it at? If it's not a fit, tell us and we'll help them another way.{status_line}

checkin_lead_3.subject: Quick check, {first}
checkin_lead_3.body:
Hi {first}, just checking in. Did {partner_first} reach you? If not, reply here and I'll help.

Justin

checkin_lead_7.subject: How's it going, {first}?
checkin_lead_7.body:
Hi {first}, it's been about a week. How's it going with {partner_first}? If you're not getting what you need, tell me and I'll find you someone who can help.

Justin

repair_lead.subject: {first}, a better fit
repair_lead.body:
Hi {first},

{old_partner_first} wasn't the right fit for this, so I'm connecting you with {partner_name}{at_company}. {partner_first} will reach out within a day or so.

You can also reach them directly: {partner_reach}.

Justin
Find Me Money Group
